title: 第21章 老太君进宫第22章 风起朝堂
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: “更重要的，只有孙儿亲自前往，以方家唯一男丁、方震天孙儿身份，才能最大程度地取信周将军他们，安抚军心。”
他走近一步，压低声音，眼中闪烁着锐利的光芒：“而且，这是一个绝佳的机会。只要孙儿到北境，见到周将军和其他旧部，便可相机行事。”
“我们方家在北境经营数十年，根基犹在。孙儿想要去亲眼看看，重新联络那些还念着方家旧情的将领士卒，为方家留一条后路，或者说，为将来可能复起，埋下种子。”
“京都虽好，却是牢笼，方家若想真正重现荣光，根基或许……仍在北境。”
这番话，如同惊雷般在老太君心中炸响。她彻底明白，方云逸所图甚大！
他不仅仅是要解决眼前兵变危机，更是要借此机会，跳出京都这个囚笼，重返方家的权力根基之地，去经营，去布局。
这份胆识，这份谋略，这份隐忍，老太君看着方云逸，仿佛看到当年丈夫方震天年轻时的影子，不，甚至比当年的丈夫更加深沉，更加果决。
她深吸一口气，努力消化着这巨大的信息冲击。良久，她重重地点点头，眼中泪光与决然交织。
“好！好！逸儿，你有此志气，祖母支持你。方家未来，就交到你手上了！”
既然已经决定方向，祖孙二人立刻行动起来。老太君亲自铺开宣纸，研墨提笔。
她虽年迈，但笔力依旧遒劲，字里行间带着真挚情感与昔日方家的份量。
信中，她先是追忆了方震天与周将军等人的袍泽之情，肯定镇北军将士保家卫国的功绩与牺牲，然后痛陈朝廷确有失当之处，理解他们的愤怒与无奈。
但紧接着，她笔锋一转，恳切劝诫他们以大局为重，以黎民百姓和北境安危为先，切不可行差踏错，背负叛军之名，让九泉之下的老将军和无数兄弟蒙羞。
她承诺，朝廷已认识到错误，陛下将下明旨赦免一切，并即刻补发所有拖欠粮饷，希望他们能相信朝廷，相信方家，释放官员，各归其位，共同抵御外敌。
信写完后，老太君取出一个紫檀木盒，里面珍藏着方震天生前的一方私印。
她郑重地蘸上印泥，在信末端端正正地盖上了“方震天印”四个朱红大字。
这方印，在北境军中，有着比圣旨更加令人信服的力量。
“有此信和此印，周将军他们……会听的。”老太君抚摸着印章，仿佛在触摸丈夫往日的荣光。
“剩下的，就等明日祖母进宫，与陛下分说。”方云逸将信件小心吹干，折叠好，放入一个特制的防水信囊中。
次日清晨，皇宫，养心殿。
乾帝看着下方恭敬行礼，却脊背挺得笔直的老太君，脸上带着恰到好处的温和与悲悯。
“老夫人快快请起。玄云宗之事，朕已严令彻查，定会还方家一个公道。北境之事，还要倚仗老夫人啊。”
老太君缓缓起身，神色平静，不卑不亢。“老身谢陛下关怀。为国分忧，乃臣子本分。”
content_en:
"More importantly, only if the grandson goes there in person, as the only male in the Fang family and the grandson of Fang Zhentian, can he win the trust of General Zhou and the others to the greatest extent and appease the morale of the army."
He took a step closer, lowered his voice, and said with a sharp light in his eyes: "Moreover, this is an excellent opportunity. As long as my grandson goes to the north and sees General Zhou and other old troops, he can act accordingly."
"Our Fang family has been operating in the north for decades, and our roots are still there. My grandson wants to see it with his own eyes, reconnect with the generals and soldiers who still remember the old friendship of the Fang family, and leave a way out for the Fang family, or in other words, plant the seeds for a possible future revival."
"Although Kyoto is good, it is a prison. If the Fang family wants to truly regain its glory, its foundation may... still be in the north."
These words exploded in the old lady's heart like thunder. She completely understood that Fang Yunyi had a big plan!
He not only wants to solve the immediate crisis of mutiny, but also wants to take this opportunity to escape from the prison of Kyoto and return to the Fang family's power base to manage and layout.
This courage, this strategy, this forbearance, the old lady looked at Fang Yunyi, as if she saw the shadow of her husband Fang Zhentian when he was young, no, even deeper and more decisive than her husband back then.
She took a deep breath and tried to digest the huge impact of information. For a long time, she nodded heavily, tears and determination intertwined in her eyes.
"Okay! Okay! Yi'er, if you have this ambition, grandma supports you. The future of the Fang family is in your hands!"
Now that the direction has been decided, the grandfather and grandson took action immediately. The old lady spread out the rice paper herself, studied the ink and picked up the pen.
Although she is old, her writing power is still strong, and her words are full of sincere emotions and the weight of the Fang family in the past.
In the letter, she first recalled the love between Fang Zhentian and General Zhou and others, affirmed the achievements and sacrifices of the soldiers of the Zhenbei Army in protecting their family and country, and then painfully stated that the court had indeed done something wrong and understood their anger and helplessness.
But then, she changed her tone and sincerely advised them to put the overall situation first and put the safety of the people and the northern border first. They must not make mistakes and bear the name of rebels, which would bring shame to the veteran generals and countless brothers.
She promised that the imperial court had realized its mistake, and his majesty would issue an express decree to pardon everything and immediately repay all arrears of food and salary. She hoped that they could trust the imperial court and the Fang family, release the officials, return them to their posts, and jointly defend against foreign enemies.
After writing the letter, the old lady took out a rosewood box, which contained Fang Zhensheng's private seal.
She solemnly dipped it in ink pad and stamped the four vermilion characters "Fang Zhentian Seal" squarely on the end of the letter.
This square seal has more convincing power than the imperial edict among the Northern Army.
"With this letter and this seal, General Zhou and the others... will listen." The old lady stroked the seal, as if touching her husband's past glory.
"The rest will be discussed with Your Majesty when my grandmother comes to the palace tomorrow." Fang Yunyi carefully dried the letter, folded it, and put it into a special waterproof envelope.
…………
Early the next morning, the Imperial Palace, Yangxin Hall.
Emperor Qian looked down at the old lady who was bowing respectfully but with her back straight, with just the right amount of gentleness and compassion on her face.
"Old Madam, please get up quickly. I have strictly ordered a thorough investigation of the Xuanyun Sect matter, and I will definitely give justice to the Fang family. For matters in the north, I still need to rely on Old Madam."
The old lady stood up slowly, her expression calm, neither humble nor arrogant. "I would like to thank Your Majesty for your concern. It is the duty of a minister to share the country's worries."
